description: Roblox’s own charts (Top Earning, Top Trending, Up-and-Coming and the rest), as RoTerminal keeps them day by day in 60 countries and on every device. With no chart and no game: the list of charts, countries and devices. With a chart: its games now, each with its place yesterday, its move, its best place and its days on the chart (put a country in front for one country’s chart: jp-up-and-coming is Japan’s Up-and-Coming). With a game: every place it holds on the charts now, worldwide and in each country (like JP-Up-and-Coming #4), and each chart’s summary.

chart.description: A chart’s id, like top-earning, top-trending or up-and-coming, with a country in front for one country’s chart, like jp-up-and-coming (optional)

country.description: A country as two letters, like JP, BR or US (optional; worldwide without it)

device.description: One device’s chart (optional; all devices without it)

game.description: The game: its name (like "grow a garden"), its universe id, its Roblox link or place id, or its roterminal.co/g/ link: every place it holds on the charts now (optional)

genre.description: For top-trending: one genre’s Trending list, like RPG or Simulation (optional)

name: charts
title: Roblox’s charts
